The first time, side ab enters the magnetic field parallel to MN; the heat generated on the wire frame is Q1, and the quantity of charge passing through the conductor cross section of the wire frame is q1. The second time, side bc enters the magnetic field parallel to MN; the heat generated on the wire frame is Q2, and the quantity of charge passing through the conductor cross section of the wire frame is q2. Then (　　)

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the rectangular conducting wire frame abcd is located on the left side of the dashed boundary MN, still outside the magnetic field; the region on the right side of MN is marked with many “×”, indicating that the uniform magnetic field is perpendicular to the plane of the paper inward. The direction in which the wire frame enters the magnetic field is perpendicular to MN. The problem states that the same rectangular wire frame completely enters the same magnetic field twice, the first time making side ab parallel to MN, and the second time making side bc parallel to MN. Then reason: Let the total resistance of the wire frame be R. During the entering process, the quantity of charge passing through any cross section of the wire-frame conductor is q=∫I dt. By Ohm's law and Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction, I=ε/R, ε=-dΦ/dt, so q=|∫(ε/R)dt|=|ΔΦ|/R. When the wire frame goes from completely outside the magnetic field to completely inside the uniform magnetic field, the initial magnetic flux is 0, and the final magnetic flux is B·S, where S=ab·bc, which is the area of the same rectangular wire frame. Whether side ab enters parallel to MN or side bc enters parallel to MN, the change in magnetic flux is the same, both being ΔΦ=BS. Therefore q1=BS/R, q2=BS/R, so q1=q2.

method.method_draft: 用磁通量变化与电荷量关系求解。先从图中读出：矩形线框最初在磁场边界 MN 外，右侧是垂直纸面向里的匀强磁场区域，线框匀速垂直 MN 进入磁场。从文字读出：两次都是同一个闭合矩形线框完全进入同一匀强磁场，只是进入时分别让 ab 边或 bc 边平行 MN。设线框总电阻为 R，进入全过程中通过任一截面的电荷量 q=∫I dt=∫(ε/R)dt。由法拉第电磁感应定律 ε=-dΦ/dt，因此 q=|ΔΦ|/R。线框从完全在磁场外到完全在磁场内，磁通量变化量均为 ΔΦ=B·S，其中 S=ab·bc，是同一矩形面积，与哪条边先进入无关，所以 q1=BS/R，q2=BS/R，得到 q1=q2。

ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the plane of the paper there is a rectangular conducting closed wire frame abcd, with side ab longer than side bc, placed outside a uniform magnetic field that is perpendicular to the plane of the paper inward and whose boundary is MN. The wire frame completely enters the magnetic field at uniform speed twice; the speeds in the two times have the same magnitude, and the directions are both perpendicular to MN. The first time, side ab enters the magnetic field parallel to MN, and the quantity of charge passing through the cross section of the wire-frame conductor is q1; the second time, side bc enters the magnetic field parallel to MN, and the quantity of charge passing through the cross section of the wire-frame conductor is q2. Compare the magnitude relationship between q1 and q2.
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure, the rectangular conducting wire frame abcd is located on the left side of the dashed boundary MN, still outside the magnetic field; the region on the right side of MN is marked with many “×”, indicating that the uniform magnetic field is perpendicular to the plane of the paper inward. The direction in which the wire frame enters the magnetic field is perpendicular to MN. The problem states that the same rectangular wire frame completely enters the same magnetic field twice, the first time making side ab parallel to MN, and the second time making side bc parallel to MN.

Then reason: Let the total resistance of the wire frame be R. During the entering process, the quantity of charge passing through any cross section of the wire-frame conductor is q=∫I dt. By Ohm's law and Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction, I=ε/R, ε=-dΦ/dt, so q=|∫(ε/R)dt|=|ΔΦ|/R. When the wire frame goes from completely outside the magnetic field to completely inside the uniform magnetic field, the initial magnetic flux is 0, and the final magnetic flux is B·S, where S=ab·bc, which is the area of the same rectangular wire frame. Whether side ab enters parallel to MN or side bc enters parallel to MN, the change in magnetic flux is the same, both being ΔΦ=BS. Therefore q1=BS/R, q2=BS/R, so q1=q2.
